findings.summary: CYCLE-6 REPAIR ROUND 1 DELIVERED NOTHING DURABLE - SECOND CONSECUTIVE EMPTY ROUND, AUDITED AS REGRESSION NOT REPAIR. Independent auditor proved via git rev-parse/diff/status --ignored that repro branch == accepted base 8bfcf85 byte-for-byte, and via exhaustive `git log --all --diff-filter=A` sweep that across EVERY ref the only cycle-6 files ever committed are Scout's two files, round-0's 18 instrumentation files and round-0's two audit files: 0 of 7 round-0 fixes delivered, no prereg, no raw evidence, no report, state stale at cycle 5. Per master-prompt section 25 the claim is downgraded to 'nothing established' (maximum_defensible_wording: establishes NOTHING about unbrowse-route-capture-replay-ladder beyond accepted cycle-5). Gate flips to PASS only when a round delivers RF-A..RF-H with the decision rule evaluated exactly once on committed raw evidence; explicit escalation trigger recorded: ONE MORE empty round => BLOCKED.

ROOT CAUSE CHAIN OF THE EMPTY ROUND (log-only; sole witness = this bundle's log): (1) Reproducer session 1 (19:32-~20:24Z) did the full repair in a git WORKTREE at /tmp/opencode/c6_repro - disclosed repairs A-J (sleep(1.2)->calibrated quiescence wait; alias-aware first-party check; Swagger try-it-out XHR observation slot; replay-side projection/acceptance slots for B/D; sealed-schedule parameter fix; terminal cart cleanup; merged-store prefix-inheritance rewrite with ground-truth matcher; boundary normalization), offline-verified 49/49 selftest at three checkpoints; (2) ~20:24:30Z an Ox/OpenCode network error + 300s stall killed the call mid-monitoring of the live confirmatory collection (P1 discovery+P2 done, P3 partial per run_all.log); (3) retry attempt 2/6 restarted a FRESH agent session at 20:29:33Z which re-derived context but could not touch its own prior worktree - 'permission requested: external_directory (/tmp/opencode/c6_repro/...)' AUTO-REJECTED at 20:32:08Z; (4) the workflow persist step runs `git add -A` in $GITHUB_WORKSPACE, which never received any change -> 'nothing to commit, working tree clean' -> forced push of byte-empty repro branch. ALL round-1 work (code fixes, drafted freeze document with frozen-implementation hash table, pilot recalibration, live collection partials) was stranded outside the persisted path and destroyed at runner teardown. New mechanism variant of the known work-delivery-loss family (extends CF-2026-08-25-10 detached-head variant and CF-05/13/22/34 permission-kill family, instance #8): agent-created /tmp worktree + post-restart external_directory wall + persist stage blind to non-workspace paths.

LATENT ROUND-0 INSTRUMENTATION DEFECTS FOUND PRE-FREEZE AND LOST WITH THE SESSION (log-only descriptions survive; the fixes themselves are gone): (a) SHOWSTOPPER - origins passed as full URLs ('https://www.demoblaze.com') while the first-party filter compared netloc, so under round-0 code EVERY host's traffic fails the first-party check and route discovery yields zero routes everywhere (exposed by the reproducer's own synthetic test asserting alias-filter behavior); (b) api.demoblaze.com XHR traffic fails the first-party origin check against origin www.demoblaze.com - would silently zero the entire pivotal demoblaze arm; (c) accept_demoblaze_replay existed but was never wired, so B/D passes on demoblaze were scored against A-side predicates (target_found/target_price keys the replay projection can never produce); (d) sealed-schedule targets resolved by intent each needed their own parameter values while round-0 passed {"id": 1}; (e) M4 enum-meaning-flip mutation class showed detected=False in the synthetic mutation-arm fixture while M1/M2/M3/M5/M6 detected - consistent with the later-audited detector blind spot. Directly relevant to anyone re-using restored round-0 tree c1543f8: the auditor-sanctioned repair path restores that tree byte-exact with ONLY RF-2 as pre-freeze code change, so defects (a)-(e) would ride along unless independently re-found.

Auditor positive verifications (what survived the empty round): Scout obligations met (snapshot a74fdb0); external-source chain re-fetched LIVE - arXiv:2604.00694 ('Internal APIs Are All You Need...', Tham/Mac Gregor Garcia/Hahn, 2026-04-01) title/authors/date and headline abstract figures match Scout records verbatim (950ms warmed cached vs 3404ms Playwright across 94 domains; 3.6x mean / 5.4x median); accepted Intel knowledge untouched (cycles 1+5 only); round-0 design facts confirmed by direct blob inspection (tasks_hosts.py:178 timed-region sleep(1.2); run_all.py:48 undisclosed pilot calibration QUIESCE_GAP_MS petstore=924.6; SEED=20260826); stale candidate sha256 4ec8e326... in repro tree vs Scout cycle-6 candidate fc5b62e9... documented in gate.

Decision-rule evaluator behaved mechanically correct on all three verdict branches in lost-session dry-runs (synthetic fixtures only, never evidence): REPRODUCED_USEFUL on success fixture (U1-U6 all true, invalid.* all false); REPRODUCED_NO_ADVANTAGE on a genuine parity fixture (U4 economics false) after the agent diagnosed its own first parity attempt as a test-fixture error (B fixed at 1990ms vs A ranging 2000-2200ms is not parity; redone with overlapping distributions); MEASUREMENT_INVALID on availability drop below the 95% floor. Invalidity clauses exercised: silent_substitution_or_checker_failure, availability_below_95pct, environment_loss_gt_20pct, infra_failures_gt_20pct, discovery_below_floor_lt3_of_4. Log-only instrument-quality signal for the repair lineage.

research_opportunities: Persist-stage hardening: either forbid agent-created worktrees outside $GITHUB_WORKSPACE during claim-bearing rounds, or make the persist step enumerate/collect known worktree locations (e.g. /tmp/opencode/*) before declaring an empty delta - would have converted this entire round into usable provenance.

Session-restart continuity: after an Ox stall-kill mid-collection, a fresh retry session should treat 'partial live collection exists in a prior worktree' as its first recovery objective instead of re-deriving context; a machine-readable checkpoint file under the mounted scout path could carry this.
The latent-defect list (finding 3) should be checked against any future use of restored round-0 ladder code c1543f8 before trusting its first-party discovery or demoblaze scoring paths.
